title: While loops
subStepTitle: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
subcategory: Things to Know in C++/Java/Python or any language
problemStatement: Repeat while a condition holds; guarantee progress toward termination.
intuition: Identify a progress measure (i increases, window shrinks, queue drains). No progress ⇒ infinite loop ⇒ TLE.

approaches.title: Initialize → condition → update
approaches.idea: All three parts must be correct.

commonMistakes: i < j vs i <= j mistakes
followUps: Convert while → for when bounds known?
interviewInsight: Narrate the progress measure out loud in live coding.
